description: This is an abstract base class for rendering document objects into RTF within the MigraDoc library. It provides utility methods for translating enum values, units, and various properties into RTF control words, and manages the rendering process for document elements.

classes.name: RendererBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for all document renderers in the MigraDoc RTF rendering subsystem, providing utility methods, translation tables, and rendering logic.

methods.name: CollectionContainsObjectAssignableTo
methods.description: Checks if the specified collection contains an object of a certain type or assignable to one of the given types.

methods.name: CreateEnumTranslationTable
methods.description: Initializes a static translation table mapping MigraDoc enums to their RTF control representations.

methods.name: ToRtfUnit
methods.description: Converts a measurement unit to an integer value suitable for RTF, based on the specified RtfUnit.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Generates RTF control words for a property, handling units, booleans, colors, or enums based on the property's value.

methods.name: TranslateBool
methods.description: Outputs an RTF control word based on a boolean property, with distinct control words for true/false.

methods.name: GetValueAsIntended
methods.description: Retrieves the property's value, considering whether to use effective values or normal values.

methods.name: RenderUnit
methods.description: Outputs an RTF control word representing a measurement unit.

methods.name: ToTwips
methods.description: Converts a Unit to twips (twentieths of a point) for RTF.

methods.name: ToEmu
methods.description: Converts a Unit to EMU (English Metric Units) for RTF.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Abstract method to render the associated document object into RTF.

methods.name: GetValueOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the property's value or a default if null.

methods.name: RenderTrailingParagraph
methods.description: Ensures a trailing paragraph is rendered if the last element isn't a paragraph, to maintain RTF structure.
